text_block_list.text: My, it's almost time for the race to start~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Right. Just to be safe,
let's stretch one more time~."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Being nervous won't do you any good~
Besides—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
We've done everything we need to, haven't we?
All that's left is to give it our all!♪
